invariants.rationale: The method returns a List, and the last operation is collect(Collectors.toList()), which returns a non-null list.
The method directly uses hoodieRecords as input for HoodieListData.eager, so it is assumed to be non-null at this point.
The returned list filters records to those for which isCurrentLocationKnown() is false, so none should have it true.
Filtering can only remove elements or leave the count unchanged, never increase it.
If the input is empty, output is empty. If the output is empty, all input records have isCurrentLocationKnown() true.
